placements.why: Tina revises the soak duration between sequential cutovers from two weeks to one week after re-analyzing Dockside exception logs and finding the previous delay was driven by a retired weekly batch reconciliation job rather than site settling time; Xavier marks the revised soak as tight rather than safe, and Tanya formally ratifies the one-week duration to supersede previous notes while holding invariant one-at-a-time sequencing and allocating the saved three weeks to the Clyde risk buffer.
